news.Title: Amazon to cut nearly 1,000 white-collar jobs across stores division and other units: report
news.Content:
Amazon is cutting fewer than 1,000 white-collar jobs, mainly in its stores division, which oversees the company's main e-commerce website, according to Reuters.

The reported cuts come as Amazon wraps up its October Prime Big Deal Days sales event, which ran Tuesday and Wednesday.

The downsizing follows a series of larger layoffs totaling roughly 30,000 jobs that began last year and continued into January.

A person familiar with the matter told Reuters that the latest round of layoffs would affect fewer than 1,000 employees.

If You'd Bought $10,000 Worth Of Amazon Stock 10 Years Ago, Here's How Much You'd Have Today

Business Insider was the first to report the latest layoffs.

Read On The Fox Business App

Internal Slack messages reviewed by Reuters and shared by affected Amazon employees suggest the cuts will affect multiple divisions across the company.

Customer service and selling partner services are expected to be affected, along with other units across the tech giant.

Employees in the U.S., India and the United Kingdom are reportedly among those affected.

Amazon Locks In Nuclear Power For 20 Years As Energy Demand Surges

"We've adjusted parts of our Stores business because we believe this structure will better enable us to deliver on our priorities," an Amazon spokesperson told Reuters.

FOX Business has reached out to Amazon for additional comment.

Amazon founder Jeff Bezos previously addressed the company's broader workforce reductions during an exclusive interview with Fox News chief political anchor Bret Baier on "Special Report."

Bezos said Amazon was in a "very special position" after substantially expanding its workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic.

He also acknowledged public fears about artificial intelligence's impact on employment, but said he disagreed with those predicting a more troubling outcome.

Fox News Digital's Stepheny Price contributed to this report.

news.Title: 台股逼近5萬點！ 他喊「不借錢投資反吃虧」網友吵翻了
news.Content: 本週眾人關注台股是否將登上5萬點大關，投資人的情緒也跟著升溫，有網友就表示，在如今的氛圍下，若按照老一輩「不借錢投資」的原則，反而可能吃虧使資產縮水？引發熱議。 老一輩總認為投資不該借錢、不開槓桿最安全，但他思考若在「收入穩定」、「現金流充足」且「留有緊急預備金」的前提下，使用房貸或增貸等相對低成本的槓桿投入股市，理論上資產累積速度較快。原PO好奇提問，「完全不借錢投資究竟是穩健還是劣勢」？文章一出隨即吸引大批網友熱烈討論。 該名網友在PTT為題「資本主義社會不借錢投資是不是其實吃虧？」發問提到以前老一輩都覺得投資不要借錢、不要槓桿最安全， 但他現在反而覺得，如今在資本主義運作的社會裡，若真的完全不利用低利率貸款投資，或許長期來說反而是吃虧的。他也假設，若借款利率長期低於投資報酬率，而本身收入穩定、現金流充足，也留有緊急預備金，是否該使用房貸、房屋增貸這種相對低成本的槓桿，將更多自有資金留在股票市場，這樣操作的話，長期資產累積速度是不是會比較快？不過，他也理解，若是槓桿開得太高，萬一遇到股災，很可能就直接「畢業」。 他想問問其他網友的看法，若按照老一輩的說法，完全不借錢投資，究竟是穩健還是劣勢？ 同時也想知道大家能接受的槓桿程度大概到哪？ 此論點吸引許多網友留言討論，有網友認為原PO的說法有其道理，認為通膨導致物價上漲快速，薪資往往跟不上，適度借貸放大投資金額，才有機會讓資產持續成長：「通膨物價一直漲，如果不靠借貸放大本金，除非薪水成長得比通膨多」、「除非你薪水成長的比通膨多啊」、「通膨物價一直漲，喜歡當牛馬就辛苦點安心點」，也有網友表示自己就是如此操作：「有房子就是要拿去貸款 各種信貸」也有網友分析「資本經濟活動就是融資出來的啊」，並點出台灣的環境優勢有利於借貸投資：「現在是台灣借貸成本太低，不借真的傻」、「別忘了現在還沒有資本利得稅」，還有人提到，一般人對負債容易有負面印象，但對於一些企業主來說，適度借錢負債反而能幫助避稅。 ▼有些網友認同原PO的看法，並指出目前台灣的環境來看，適度借貸投資才能設法不讓資產因通膨縮水，但也有網友提醒，每個人的風險承受與個人投資能力不同，借貸投資之前必須謹慎評估。（示意圖／AI生成） 至於操作方式，有網友從「貸款與資產屬性」切入分析，認為借貸本身沒有絕對的好壞，關鍵在於個人是否能搞清楚適合自己的方式。有房產的人透過房屋貸款或質押取得資金，與無腦高利借貸炒股截然不同。正如公司高層為了發展事業向銀行借錢一樣，理財也是相同的邏輯，只要能確保槓桿程度適度可控，且自身具備承受損失的能力，合理的借貸便能成為資金運用的工具，否則貿然跟風只會成為市場中的韭菜。 不過，也有人提醒投資並非穩賺不賠，每個人的風險承受與個人投資能力不同，借貸投資之前必須謹慎評估。加上原PO所說「借款利率會長期低於投資報酬率」的「低利負債」只存在於假設中，現實中無法有此保證：「沒人可以保證借款利率長期低於投資報酬率，而且也沒有人保證無限續借，銀行最會雨天收傘」、「低利是有能力的人低利，不是每個人都低利」也有人指出，所謂開槓桿的本質是放大本金，但能成功的前提必須建立在「有賺錢」與「高勝率」之上，若只是盲目借錢出來直接ALL IN，萬一遇到空頭市場到來或股市大暴跌時，就很可能損失慘重甚至可能連累家人：如果股市大暴跌要你追繳保證金，你得去求親友或不擇手段犧牲別人或去向地下錢莊借錢，那就不要玩」，因此不少人認為，借貸投資之前，應先學會提高投資勝率、搞懂風險管理，遠比盲目借錢更重要：「先學會提高勝率，再來談借錢，否則你借的錢就只是金融股股東的股利來源而已」。

news.Title: 《韓股》風險偏好明顯降溫 KOSPI重挫2.62%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-08 16:49:55 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(8)日收盤走弱，韓國KOSPI指數收於6625.93點，下跌177.97點或2.62%，連續第三個交易日下跌；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於892.27點，下跌6.16點或0.69%。韓股連續第三個交易日走跌，係受到國際油價上升引發通膨疑慮，加上美股前一交易日回檔影響，市場風險偏好明顯降溫。

宏觀壓力方面，美國10年期公債殖利率走高，加上油價攀升，使投資人更擔心物價壓力延續。市場同時消化聯準會年底前仍可能再度升息的訊號，外圍氛圍偏空，韓股開高後旋即走低，賣壓隨後擴大。

半導體權值股方面，Samsung Electronics(005930.KS)公布第三季營業利益達107.4兆韓元、創新高，但股價仍出現獲利了結壓力，SK hynix(000660.KS)股價亦走弱，拖累KOSPI指數表現；大型半導體股未能將財報利多轉化為追價動能，成為指數下挫的主因之一。

類股方面，KOSPI成分股中，SK Square(402340.KS)、Hanwha Aerospace(012450.KS)等大型股走弱，LG Energy Solution(373220.KS)與Samsung SDI(006400.KS)相對抗跌。KOSDAQ成分股中，Alteogen(196170.KS)、Rainbow Robotics(277810.KS)、HLB(028300.KS)等生技與機器人概念回檔，但Jusung Engineering(036930.KS)、Wonik IPS(240810.KS)與EcoPro BM(247540.KS)等半導體與電池相關個股表現較佳。

news.Title: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Could Have Big News on Oct. 15
news.Content:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM) is one of the unsung heroes of the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution. The company makes the chips used in AI development, and it partners with all of the major semiconductor companies.

TSMC's stock is up 440% over the past three years, and it's now the sixth-largest company in the world, with a $2.5 trillion market cap.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The company reports third-quarter earnings on Oct. 15, and there could be some important news. Here's what to look out for.

Investing for future growth

TSMC, is the largest chip foundry in the world, and it has a dominant position, responsible for 73% of global semiconductor manufacturing revenue . Its market share increased over the past few years since it's the only company capable of producing the advanced chips its clients need for powerful AI processes at scale.

The company's client base includes all of the major AI chip developers like Nvidia and Amazon , and TSMC is expanding its edge by opening new fabs both in its native Taiwan as well as other global regions, including the U.S. It opened its Arizona location last year, and it's planning to expand that into a cluster of six facilities to meet the high-level needs of clients like Nvidia and Apple , which was its largest client until this year, when Nvidia superceded it.

TSMC and Nvidia had a joint celebration when Nvidia's Blackwell graphics processing units (GPU) were the first chips to roll off the Arizona fab's machines last year, and TSMC is planning to invest $265 billion in the location to produce three and then two-nanometer chip development.

Management is seizing the opportunity to create the infrastructure to handle incoming demand, and it's excited about the future.

What to expect in the third quarter

Management said that it expects some gross margin contract in the back of the year before any incremental benefits from greater capacity. Its outlook includes:

Revenue of $45.2 billion, a 37% increase over last year.

Gross margin of 66%, up from 59.5% last year.

Operating margin of 57%, up from 50.6% last year.

It also noted that while it's taking memory cost increases into consideration, it still expects high demand. It also pointed out that the rise of agentic AI is creating a need for central processing units (CPU), which it can fill. "We believe this is positive for TSMC, as no matter what CPU approach is taken," said CEO C.C. Wei. "They are almost all TSMC's customers."

Story Continues

Longer term, the company expects higher capital expenditures (capex) over the next three years, and while the market tends to dislike high capex spend, it sees it as a positive update for TSMC. That's likely because it's an expansion of the company's profitable business rather than a stab at a possibly viable venture. Wei said that the company forecasts capex spend based on demand, and that it expects 2027 to be a very good year.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing usually beats on guidance, and if it has positive updates about its U.S. expansion or new deals, the stock could jump. Whatever happens on Oct. 15, though, it's a great stock to own for the long term .

news.Title: 名師操盤》台股暴殺多方這時表態 台塑等10檔強棒成新寵
news.Content:
美國長天期公債殖利率再度攀升，引發市場對通膨及升息的擔憂，美股漲多整理。周四的台股，隨著美股拉回，加上國慶連假在即，指數開低震盪，權值電子普遍拉回，終場下跌492點，以49,313點作收，K線收黑K，連假前未能挑戰5萬點大關成功。成交量為8,696億元，較前一日的9,259億元，持續價跌量縮。

以日K線來看，由於節前賣壓湧現，周四出現黑K，當日收盤位置49,313點低於前一日低點49,567點，等於日K出現日級別日落訊號的前兆，短線由空方略佔上風。

至於OTC指數，周四也是出現當日收盤位置426.71點低於前一日低點429.72點，日K同步出現日級別日落訊號的前兆，短線也由空方略佔上風。

連假之後，10月15日台積電法說會的重要性增加，那裡是一個多方表態的機會，日落的考驗要靠日出來化解。

以台股的日KD指標來看，儘管周四日KD值持續維持在80之上第4天，但因數值出現日KD高檔交叉向下，行情震盪難免。

後續觀察日KD值能否持續停在80以上，能在80以上超過一周，個股才容易出現賺錢效應，盤面的可操作性才會增加。

以周四收盤時來看，上市的上漲家數424家，下跌家數549家；上櫃的上漲家數334家，下跌家數413家，上市櫃合計的下跌家數大於上漲家數。

周四上市漲停家數為13檔，上櫃漲停家數為23檔，合計漲停家數為36檔，低於40家的基本觀察門檻，顯示買盤持續觀望，這與連假將至有關。

盤面上，近期提到資金輪動迅速，輪番上攻，也輪流整理。

先前提過傳產轉型半導體，跨足AI趨勢已經成了近期熱點。繼半導體潔淨管的大甲股價大漲後，日前台塑集團攜手半導體特化的中華化，加速布建電子化學品製造基地，加速轉型半導體領域的態勢明顯。

今年持續鎖定的台塑集團，不只南亞大漲，台塑、台化、台塑化也加入輪漲的行情，周四股價表現強勢。過去的台塑四寶在加了AI或台積電供應鏈的光環後，後續市場評價可望上修，值得持續鎖定。

至於同樣看好的被動元件，隨著日韓業者進行產品策略調整，減少消費端供給、增加AI應用端供給，台廠可望享有訂單外溢效應。如光頡、禾伸堂、九豪、勤凱等，周四股價續強，可持續追蹤；而國巨、華新科等整理後，也可留意。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》個人化廣告技術—META、PUBM、APP
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-08 16:39:04 數位內容中心 發佈

Meta Platforms（META.US）

news.Title: 3 Chip Stocks Up Over 6,000% in a Decade: 2 to Buy Now and 1 to Avoid
news.Content:
The semiconductor industry has been one of the most lucrative sectors to invest in over the past decade, with three stocks posting gains of over 6,000%. Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) leads the pack with a more than 14,000% return during that stretch, followed by Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) with a gain of over 9,000% and Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) at more than 6,000%.

So, which of these chip stocks still looks like a buy for the next decade? Let's take a closer look at why Nvidia and AMD remain buys, and why I'd pass on Micron.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

1. Nvidia

Nvidia's decade of dominance stems from its graphics processing units (GPUs) becoming the primary chips for AI workloads, particularly for training AI models. The company created a wide moat in AI model training by seeding its CUDA software platform in places doing early AI research, leading to most foundational AI code being written on its software and optimized for its chips. That moat remains today.

However, the next decade will be about Nvidia's transition from a GPU maker to a full-fledged AI infrastructure company. Networking has been one of Nvidia's fastest-growing businesses, and it has developed its own central processing units (CPUs), which are becoming more important with agentic AI.

Meanwhile, Nvidia's acquisition of "Groq" and its language processing units (LPUs) earlier this year set it up well for inference . This all allows it to offer complete end-to-end server solutions for specific AI tasks. It has also made important software-layer acquisitions with SchedMD and Hugging Face.

A huge winner over the past decade, Nvidia is well-positioned for the next 10 years, making the stock a buy.

2. Advanced Micro Devices

Despite ceding the AI training market to Nvidia's GPUs, AMD's performance over the past decade has nonetheless been impressive. Many of these gains have come recently, as the chipmaker has positioned itself well in three key markets: inference, agentic AI, and physical AI.

Inference is more memory-bound than compute-constrained, and AMD has made important strides in capturing enterprise workloads constrained by memory availability and costs. Its chiplet designs allow its GPUs to be packaged with more high bandwidth memory (HBM), and it has recently acquired memory optimization company MEXT and inference chipmaker Taalas, which hardwire AI models into its chips. AMD has broken into the inference market with two $100 billion deals with Meta Platforms and OpenAI, as well as a large deal with Anthropic.

Story Continues

In addition to its opportunity in inference, the company is also a leader in data center CPUs. The server CPU market is exploding due to the rise of agentic AI, with Bank of America recently projecting it will rise from $19 billion in 2025 to $180 billion in 2030. That's huge growth, and the Wall Street firm also expects AMD to continue to take market share in the space.

Finally, following its announced acquisition of World Labs, AMD is also looking to tackle the physical AI and robotics markets. World Lab is a leader in the spatial AI models that will eventually play a big role in these markets, positioning AMD to become a strong player in the space.

Given its opportunities in inference, agentic AI, and physical AI, this is a stock to own for the next decade.

3. Micron Technology

Micron has posted spectacular gains over the past decade, with its stock going parabolic since the spring of 2025. These gains are tied directly to surging memory prices, as both DRAM (dynamic random access memory) and NAND (flash) have been in short supply. Much of this is tied to soaring AI demand, especially for HBM, which essentially needs to be packaged with GPUs.

But while much of the industry is focused on HBM, Micron has actually benefited from being a next-generation memory laggard. Conventional memory prices have climbed faster than HBM, which has helped Micron's revenue and gross margins skyrocket. But here's the twist: Being the technology laggard isn't a good long-term strategy, and it is most exposed to ordinary memory prices normalizing.

So don't let the stock's cheap valuation fool you; this isn't the memory stock to own over the long term. I much prefer HBM leader and primary Nvidia supplier SK Hynix (NASDAQ: SKHY).

news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉CPO族群、半導體類股領跌　滬指終止連2紅
news.Content:
中國A股三大指數今(8)日在結束一周長假後向下補跌，創業板領跌，上證指數( SSEC )亦結束連2個交易日走漲氣勢，因市場認為經濟復甦前景存在不確定性，且缺乏新的經濟數據刺激。

滬指今日收低0.79%至3811.9點，深證成指( SZI )收低2.07%至12620.9點，創業板指收跌3.15%至3036.66點，科創50指數收黑4.82%至1456.32點，滬深兩市成交額人民幣1.68兆元，較上一交易日放量2441億元

盤面上，半導體、CPO等AI硬體股表現不佳，光通訊方向領跌，源傑科技、長光華芯、東山精密、沃格光電、均勝電子等股跌停，天孚通訊午後跌超10%；半導體產業鏈震盪調整，DRAM龍頭長鑫科技盤中跌超8%，思瑞浦、微導奈米、聖邦股份等亦紛紛下挫。

上漲族群方面，石油石化族群領漲兩市，博邁科、通源石油漲超7%；公用事業類股亦漲幅居前，國新能源、廣西能源等漲停；銀行族群盤中震盪走強，中國銀行、工商銀行、杭州銀行日內創歷史新高；固態電池概念股逆勢活躍，力王股份、雄韜股份、豐元股份、領湃科技漲停，傳藝科技與紫竹高科連三根漲停；航運類股亦表現佳，中遠海能、招商南油漲停。

根據Wind統計數據，滬深兩市及北交所共1696檔股票上漲，3742檔下跌，平盤126檔。另據大智慧VIP，滬深北三市共68檔股票漲幅在9%以上。

華泰證券表示，假期前一周市場繼續量縮震盪，結構上高低切換延續，創新藥、地產、銀行等相對佔優，通訊、半導體等仍在消化擁擠度。假期期間增量資訊整體偏向正面；中國9月製造業PMI重回擴張區間，假期消費數據總量平穩、結構分化，加上首套房貸財政貼息落地；海外方面，非農就業數據弱勢下，股漲債滯，那指100創新高。結合長假後日曆效應，節前A股已出現較明顯調整，獲利預期穩定，節後可望放量回升，建議繼續沿獲利、低擁擠與低波動再平衡關注。

長江證券認為，假期期間，10年期美債殖利率突破5.3%後仍然沒有壓制科技股，這說明現階段全球資金仍願意為確定性景氣資產支付較高估值。整體而言，海外主要市場正進入「宏觀仍有壓力，但資金重新選擇最強獲利資產」的階段，因此建議投資者專注於有獲利、有訂單、有產業趨勢的科技核心資產。對假期後的A股而言，指數預計維持震盪偏強運行格局，風格上科技可望重新佔優，重點關注AI硬體板塊的反彈機會。另外，商業航太和創新藥等概念也有望表現活躍。

中信建投則出具研報指出，海外AI安全討論尚未改變模型高頻迭代節奏，RSI逐步成為OpenAI、Anthropic等主要模型企業共識；阿里巴巴、智譜分別完成約800億港元、50億美元融資，規模化投入支撐模型能力追趕，騰訊亦加大海外算力採購。中國AI族群整體趨勢上行，建議關注算力服務、國產晶片與超節點及具備場景、資料及企業交付能力的B端AI應用廠商。

news.Title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Fired Back at President Donald Trump's Interest Rate Critiques With a Blunt 9-Word Statement
news.Content:
This has been a history-packed year for Wall Street. The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJINDICES:^DJI), S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC), and Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) have all catapulted to several new highs, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh was sworn in as only the 17th head of the Fed on May 22.

But the most game-changing event of them all might be Warsh and the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) kicking off only the fourth interest rate-hiking cycle of the 21st century on Sept. 16. Fed Chair Warsh and 11 other FOMC colleagues voted unanimously (12-0) to raise the federal funds target rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00%.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Kevin Warsh and the FOMC just shifted to a rate-hiking cycle. Image source: Official Federal Reserve Photo.

President Donald Trump hasn't been shy about voicing his displeasure with the FOMC's stance on interest rates. But in Warsh's comments to the press following the Sept. 15-16 FOMC meeting, he indirectly fired back at Donald Trump's ongoing interest rate critiques.

President Trump has frequently thrown the Fed under the bus over interest rates

Shortly after the start of President Trump's second non-consecutive term in January 2025, he began regularly criticizing then-Fed Chair Jerome Powell and the FOMC for not lowering interest rates quickly enough. Even though the FOMC enacted six rate cuts from September 2024 to December 2025, the president opined that interest rates should be at or below 1%.

Trump's logic is straightforward: lower lending rates would spur hiring and spending on Wall Street's leading catalyst, the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure build-out.

Lower borrowing costs would also ease the pain of servicing America's rapidly rising total debt, which surpassed $40 trillion in August. If Treasury bond yields decline, persistent federal deficits wouldn't be as damning.

Following the September FOMC meeting, President Trump took a very subtle jab at Fed Chair Warsh for not voting against what he refers to as a "very hostile" board. But according to the head of the central bank, rate hikes were completely justified.

Image source: Getty Images.

Fed Chair Warsh charts a path to price stability

Following the FOMC's decision to raise interest rates by a quarter point, ABC News reporter Elizabeth Schulze asked Warsh what his message would be for the president, knowing he's repeatedly called for rate cuts. Kevin Warsh had a blunt response:

Story Continues

I've got nothing for you on the – on the discussion with the president... The decision we made today was the right decision to deliver on the remit that Congress gave us to ensure stable prices.

These nine words, "The decision we made today was the right decision," leave no room for interpretation. Fed Chair Warsh and his peers knew they had to get aggressive to combat persistently elevated inflation, and raising the federal funds target rate is their most effective tool to stabilize prices.

Fed Chair Warsh's language also strongly hints that this won't be a one-and-done rate hike. He referred to his action as removing a "dose of accommodation" in his prepared remarks. While a single dose of medicine can temporarily relieve a headache, several doses are needed to combat a fever. The way Warsh has described inflation as too high for too long indicates that several doses of accommodation will need to be removed to deliver price stability.

That's a warning to President Trump and to a historically pricey AI-driven stock market.

news.Title: 3 Dividend Stocks Down Between 23% and 30% to Buy Right Now and Hold for a Decade
news.Content:
It's a fact of life in the stock market -- every stock goes through a bad stretch at some point. Sometimes the down cycle can be just a few days, and sometimes it extends for a year or more and becomes hard to stomach.

But I always believe that investors should take a long-term view when considering their holdings. Because in the grand scheme of things, one bad year is a drop in the bucket of a company's lifespan. And if a company has good management and a sound business plan, then today's downturn provides prospective investors with an opportunity to take a position at a discounted price.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Three dividend stocks that I have my eye on are Pool Corp. (NASDAQ: POOL), International Business Machines (NYSE: IBM), and McDonald's (NYSE: MCD). These are great companies going through a bad stretch and currently are down between 23% and 30% for the year.

But I'm betting that they will turn around sooner rather than later.

Pool Corp.: Down 30%

You can probably guess from the name, but Pool Corp. is in the swimming pool business. The Louisiana-based company sells swimming pool products, supplies, and parts, as well as outdoor equipment.

The challenge for Pool right now is that interest rates are high, pushing mortgages to more than 7%. The National Association of Realtors says existing home sales dropped 2% from July to August, the most recent data available, and the number of available homes on the market continues to increase. In that economic market, it's even more challenging to commit to a swimming pool installation that could cost tens of thousands of dollars.

But not all is lost. The pools currently in use need maintenance and repair, and that's been good for the company's bottom line. The company is seeing significant growth in its Pool360 program, a digital ecosystem that provides pool contractors and retailers with real-time inventory and pricing, water-testing software, and business management software. Pool360 accounted for more than 17% of the company's revenue in the second quarter.

Net sales in the quarter were $1.82 billion, up 2% from a year ago, with adjusted operating income of $275.9 million (up 1%) and adjusted diluted earnings of $5.38 per share, up 4%.

Pool stock has a dividend yield of 3.3%, providing a reliable income stream.

Story Continues

IBM: Down 25%

IBM has long been one of my favorite tech stocks, and part of the reason is the attractive dividend. IBM is currently yielding 3%, which is an outstanding return for a tech stock.

The company is having a bad year, however, because it got burned pretty badly in Q2 by the industry's run on memory and storage. That's why Sandisk is up 600% on the year.

But for IBM, it's been damaging to the stock price. The company missed on Q2 earnings because several big deals were delayed and failed to close before IBM shut the books on its quarter. "These conditions require our teams to execute perfectly, and this quarter we faltered," CEO Arvind Krishna wrote in a letter to shareholders.

IBM didn't have a terrible quarter. Revenue was $17.16 billion, up 1.1% from a year ago, and net income of $2.16 billion was down from $2.19 billion. I'll be interested to see if Q3 numbers bounce back when the company next reports later this month.

McDonald's: Down 23%

McDonald's has a mammoth footprint, with more than 44,000 locations worldwide. The company says it feeds 70 million people a day, and its Big Macs and fries have become quintessential fast-food staples. And it has a growing digital presence, with more than 220 million people using the McDonald's app at least once every 90 days.

But the second quarter wasn't a great one for the Golden Arches. McDonald's global comparable-store sales only increased 1.3% from a year ago, and the U.S. market was even softer, with just 0.8% growth.

The newest initiative is ArchIQ, an AI-powered restaurant operating system designed to improve productivity and free up employees to focus on food preparation and customers. That's part of an $8.5 billion overhaul that also includes an AI drive-through ordering tool called Archy, kitchen upgrades, and in-store lockers to streamline mobile delivery pickups.

McDonald's has plenty of work to do. In the meantime, investors who hold onto McDonald's stock are being rewarded with a 3.3% yield.

news.Title: Should You Buy Stocks in October? History’s Answer is Strikingly Clear.
news.Content:
October has been known for some of the worst stock market events in history, from the crash of 1929 to Black Monday in 1987. And more recently, the subprime market collapse triggered a stock market crash that also took place in the month of October.

That is why many investors may worry about investing right now. Though the S&P 500 has advanced in the double digits this year, a number of concerns have periodically weighed on the market -- and at any point, one or more of these could lead to declines. These include general risks such as a difficult economy, as well as industry-specific concerns such as the pace of investment in the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure build-out.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Though August was a bright month for stocks, with the S&P 500 climbing more than 2% and corporate earnings hitting it out of the park, September finished in the doldrums with a loss of 0.4%. Against this backdrop, you may be asking yourself whether you should buy stocks in October. History's answer is strikingly clear.

Image source: Getty Images.

What's driven this bull market

First, let's take a closer look at what's driven this bull market in recent years and the elements of concern that have emerged. AI stocks have powered benchmarks, including the S&P 500, higher over the past few years amid optimism regarding this technology's potential to supercharge earnings growth. AI applied to the needs of businesses could make them more efficient, lower their costs, and support innovation. And these are just a few of the benefits AI can bring. All of this is very positive for a company's long-term financial picture.

As a result, investors piled into AI stocks , and these players -- often tech giants heavily weighted in the S&P 500 -- drove the benchmark higher. But, as the spending levels of these companies increased to pay for the AI build-out, some investors worried that they may be spending too much too quickly. Big tech players have pledged to invest nearly $700 billion this year alone in the ramp-up. The concern is that the future revenue opportunity may not justify such spending levels.

Meanwhile, the general economic environment has become less favorable for growth, with inflation climbing and an initial interest rate increase put into place to tame it.

Story Continues

All of this has weighed on the minds of investors in recent times, and that's hurt appetite for growth stocks, particularly those in the AI space.

Some of the worst market events ever

Now, let's turn to our question: Against this backdrop, should you really buy stocks in October? As I mentioned above, this month has been known for some of the worst market events in history. But if we look at market performance overall in the month of October, it actually isn't bad. From 1991 through today, the S&P 500 rose 66% of the time in the month of October, according to E*TRADE from Morgan Stanley . And 61% of Octobers since 1957 have been positive, the data show.

Meanwhile, it's important to consider stocks and the index beyond just one month. Performance over time shows the S&P 500 has always gone on to deliver a win to investors who have held on for a period of years.

^SPX data by YCharts

So if you happen to buy stocks even right before a tough time, if you hold on for the long term, you're likely to score a win. For example, if you had invested right before Black Monday in 1987 and held on for five years, your investment would have climbed 68%, according to BlackRock 's iShares. The data show that this trend holds true after other crashes, too, though in some cases investors had to hold on longer than five years.

History's answer to our question is strikingly clear: Yes, you should invest in October as long as you choose quality stocks that are trading at reasonable levels. If you hold on for the long term, one-month performance is almost meaningless -- and this means that any time could be the right time to get in on stocks.

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》空間運算/混合實境—META、AAPL、QCOM
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-08 16:16:22 數位內容中心 發佈

Meta Platforms（META.US）

10月6日，Meta正式向開發者釋出Meta VR Glasses建置指引，確認新裝置與Meta Quest共用同一作業系統、engines、軟體開發套件（SDKs）與samples。既有Quest App也可透過Device Readiness Check與agentic tooling補上眼動與手部支援。

Apple（AAPL.US）

Qualcomm（QCOM.US）

10月5日，Qualcomm與華為共同宣布簽署多年期廣泛專利授權協議，涵蓋5G、運算、人工智慧（AI）與網路等領域，並包含Qualcomm買下部分美國專利的所有權移轉。這使XR與智慧眼鏡所需的連網與終端運算智慧財產（IP）整合再往前一步。

XREAL

本週，Xreal開放Aura智慧眼鏡預購，12GB加256GB版本售價1279美元，16GB加512GB版本售價1499美元。產品採分離式運算架構，把Snapdragon Reality Elite放在外接compute puck，並公布95公克重量與70度視場角。

Snap（SNAP.US）

news.Title: Prediction: The S&P 500 Will Hit 10,000 in 2027
news.Content:
The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) is closing in on another strong year in 2026, up roughly 14% year to date after closing on Oct. 7 at 7,801. The current bull market is around four years old, having begun in October 2022, but I think stocks have plenty of upside ahead. In fact, I predict the S&P 500 will hit 10,000 in 2027. That would be another 28% gain from here.

Here's why I think the S&P 500 will hit 10,000 next year.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

A cheap market and a historically strong period ahead

While there is a lot of talk about the market being at a historically high valuation when using metrics like the CAPE ratio and Buffett indicator (the market's total market cap divided by GDP), the S&P 500 is actually at its cheapest level in more than 30 years when using a more traditional PEG (price/earnings-to-growth) ratio.

According to Yardeni Research, the S&P 500 currently has a PEG of around 0.7, based on five-year forward growth estimates. That's well below the 1.3 times the index has averaged over time, and only the fifth time it's dipped below 1 since at least 1995.

The S&P 500 would have to rise by about 43% just to reach a PEG of 1 and about 86% to return to its 1.3 average. This gives the market plenty of room to run.

Meanwhile, many of the low PEG ratios in the S&P 500 are concentrated in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure stocks. Stocks like Nvidia , Broadcom , Advanced Micro Devices , and Micron Technology have minuscule PEG ratios. So, if the S&P 500 is going to climb toward 10,000, it likely will be led once again by AI stocks.

That said, market breadth has been quite low, with AI stocks remaining strong while other sectors have struggled. Any catch-up from market laggards over the next year would also be a boost to the S&P 500 and help push it to the 10,000 market.

In addition to valuation and the potential for laggards to rebound, the stock market is also just about to enter its strongest historical period. The S&P 500 has historically performed best in the quarters following midterm elections, rising 95% of the time the following year (November to November). Meanwhile, this period has also produced the strongest stock returns, with the S&P 500 up an average of 14.5% in the 12 months following, according to Fidelity.

Story Continues

In fact, according to the Carson Group, we are right at the start of the two best quarters historically for owning stocks. The S&P 500 has risen 84% of the time since 1950, averaged a 6.6% return during the fourth quarter of a midterm election year, and climbed 95% of the time in calendar Q1 of the year following midterm elections, gaining 7.4% over these three months. Calendar Q2 in the year following midterms also isn't too shabby, producing an average gain of 5% and increasing 74% of the time.

How to invest

When the market nears a milestone, it tends to hit it, so I think between a cheap overall market valuation and a strong historical period for stocks, the S&P 500 should hit 10,000 toward the end of next year. AI stocks will likely lead the way, but I'd also expect some improved market breadth to help.

The S&P 500 isn't guaranteed to hit 10,000 next year, and the index's performance will depend heavily on continued investment in AI infrastructure. The index is now heavily weighted toward megacap tech stocks, so a lot is riding on the AI trade. Still, companies appear to be getting strong returns on their investments, so I expect AI to have a long runway still ahead.

Meanwhile, the best way to invest in the S&P 500 is through an exchange-traded fund (ETF) like the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (NYSEMKT: VOO), which is a great, low-cost way to mimic the index's returns.

news.Title: 群聯9月營收連十月創高；AI應用占比已逾半
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-08 15:54:56 周佩宇 發佈

NAND控制晶片暨AI應用儲存解決方案整合服務領導廠群聯電子(8299；Phison)今日公布今(2026)年9月合併營收為306.39億元，月增8%、年增370%，連十月創單月新高；第3季合併營收860.77億元，季增27%、年增375%，連六季寫新高；累計前三季合併營收1949.32億元，年增291%，創歷年同期新高。

群聯執行長潘健成(附圖)表示，AI與伺服器市場需求依舊強勁，AI正從大型資料中心持續向企業、工廠、醫療、教育及各種工作場域延伸，並帶動儲存、運算、網路及AI基礎建設相關需求同步成長。

他進一步分析，群聯9月營收結構亮點在AI Ecosystem modules，包括eSSD、aiDAPTIV solution、AI PC、AI Networking、AI Server及Boot Drive開機碟等AI相關應用，營收貢獻度已超過整體營收50%，這代表AI對群聯而言，已經不只是單一產品的機會，而是涵蓋儲存、運算、網路及AI應用的完整生態系。未來隨著AI推論需求持續增加，企業對高效能儲存、AI運算與資料管理的需求也將同步提升，群聯將持續透過Phison 3.0策略，擴大轉型為邊緣AI基礎建設及AI應用的賦能者。

潘健成說，除了AI硬體需求持續成長外，公司的AI資料平台（AI Data Platform）正在逐步驗證地端AI的實際應用價值。以醫療場域為例，由於病患資料具有高度敏感性，許多AI應用必須在地端環境執行，無法完全依賴雲端服務；同時，醫療機構也需要解決AI模型、GPU資源管理以及實際工作流程整合等問題。

群聯透過完整的AI Data Platform架構，結合GPU資源管理及AI模型應用能力，協助醫療場域將AI真正導入日常工作流程。例如目前醫療相關AI應用已涵蓋醫師問診與病歷生成、住院病例、護理交班與護理紀錄，以及護理教育與學習等工作，透過Fine-tuned AI模型、RAG(檢索增強生成)、及群聯的AI Data Platform整合技術，能協助醫護人員減少大量重複性文書工作。實際導入結果顯示，醫療AI整體使用滿意度達90%，部分工作流程的文件產製時間更可縮短約50%以上。

news.Title: 日本兩大券商看好日股衝8萬點 就怕AI投資變臉
news.Content:
日本兩大證券商預期，日本股市漲勢將延續至2027年，但AI投資可能逆轉，是市場面臨的主要威脅。

野村控股執行長奧田健太郎周四(8日)在東京一場日經活動上表示：「AI投資正強力帶動市場、股價與企業獲利。如果市場對AI的態度改變，使這股趨勢逆轉，我認為可能構成重大風險。」

規模較小的同業、大和證券集團執行長荻野明彥，也在同場座談中表達類似看法。

兩人均預期日經225指數( NKY ) 將達到8萬點，但對時間的判斷不同。荻野預估今年就能達標，奧田則預期今年底約為7萬5000點，2027年底突破8萬點。日經指數周四收在69,042.11點。

兩人的發言反映出對日本股市近四年多頭行情的信心。AI投資、公司治理改革及通膨回歸帶動投資人買進，推升日股至接近歷史高點。這波漲勢也挹注兩家證券商的獲利，雙方上個會計年度均創下獲利新高。

荻野預期，日經指數將在2027年底前後升至8萬8000點，期間日元匯率約維持在1美元兌160日元。奧田則預估，今年底匯率約為1美元兌156日元，隨著地緣政治疑慮緩解，日元之後將逐步升值。

荻野將日元近期從過度弱勢中回升，歸因於聯合干預、美國財政部長貝森特呼籲日本銀行升息，以及日本銀行9月升息。他形容利率上升是反映經濟成長的「正面發展」。

奧田表示，海外投資人對日本仍有濃厚興趣，升息至今尚未造成明顯負面影響。他並指出，中東與烏克蘭衝突可能延續，進而推升能源價格、擾亂供應鏈。

兩人均指出，美國等國近期民眾對AI與資料中心的反對聲浪，可能導致該領域投資減少。

荻野表示：「最令人擔憂的是市場參與者會如何反應。他們可能在極短時間內大幅改變看法，造成資產價格劇烈波動。這些市場波動可能放大風險的影響，遠超過實體經濟實際發生的變化。我認為這是最大的挑戰。」

news.Title: Prediction: The Number That Will Move Intel Stock in October Isn't Revenue
news.Content:
Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) will post its third-quarter results after the bell on Thursday, Oct. 29. If the past year is any guide, revenue could be the least surprising number in the release.

Intel's revenue has topped its own forecast in seven straight quarters. And the latest one wasn't close: Second-quarter revenue of $16.1 billion was $1.8 billion over the midpoint of management's guidance. Investors have noticed. Shares trade near $114 as of this writing, about triple where they began 2026.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

But a business can sell more chips than it planned and still struggle to profit from them. I think the number that matters most this month is Intel 's gross margin (the percentage of sales Intel keeps after paying to build its products). And its climb has slowed sharply.

Image source: Intel.

Revenue has been the easy part

For the third quarter, management forecast revenue of $15.8 billion to $16.8 billion. The $16.3 billion midpoint works out to about 19% growth year over year, a drop from the second quarter's 25% rate. Yet that's strong for a business whose revenue was flat in 2025.

Hitting the range could depend more on Intel's factories than on its customers. In its second-quarter filing, Intel said demand for both its PC and server chips exceeded the supply it had available, and it expects industrywide shortages of substrates, memory, and other parts to run into next year. That means revenue will probably track how many chips Intel's plants can make.

Gross margin is different. It reflects yields at those plants, the early costs of ramping Intel 18A (its latest manufacturing process), what Intel pays for memory and other inputs, and the prices it can charge.

Is the margin still climbing?

Intel's non-GAAP (adjusted) gross margin was 37.9% in the fourth quarter of 2025. It jumped to 41% in the first quarter of 2026, then inched up again in the second quarter, to 41.8%. For the third quarter, management forecast around 42% (41% on a GAAP basis). Each rise has been smaller than the last -- a gain of 3.1 percentage points, then 0.8 points, then a guided 0.2 points. Plus, 42% would be only around 2 points over the 40% Intel reported for the third quarter of 2025.

Intel's margin beats have been shrinking, too. The first quarter's 41% topped Intel's 34.5% guidance by around 6.5 points, helped partly by sales of previously reserved inventory.

Story Continues

The second quarter's 41.8% beat the 39% guidance by around 2.8 points, helped by higher factory yields.

"We were very pleased with Q1 gross margins and we will continue to push for gross margin expansion. It is my top priority," CFO David Zinsner said in April, in his comments on Intel's first-quarter results.

In those same comments, though, Zinsner said Intel 18A was still early in its ramp and that climbing input costs, especially memory, were "growing headwinds in the second half."

The valuation needs more than 42%

At the guided revenue midpoint, one percentage point of gross margin is worth around $160 million of gross profit a quarter. That's about 6% of the $2.8 billion in adjusted operating income Intel earned in the second quarter.

And the share price leaves little room for a margin that stalls. At around $114, Intel has a price-to-earnings ratio of about 55 using expected 2027 earnings. Measured against its adjusted earnings over the last four quarters, the ratio is above 100. Investors are already paying for profits that haven't arrived yet.

To be fair, the margin might keep rising. Intel said in July it had lowered the cost of its main Panther Lake chip made on 18A by around 50% so far in 2026, with another 20% drop expected by year-end.

But spending is climbing, too. Intel lifted its 2026 capital spending outlook to over $20 billion and expects 2027 spending to be much higher. New factories and equipment carry depreciation costs that might hurt gross margin when they come online.

Another revenue beat on Oct. 29 might be welcome, but it likely won't tell investors much they don't already know. A gross margin comfortably above 42%, plus a fourth-quarter forecast that keeps it rising, would arguably show the turnaround reaching profits.

A margin that just meets the 42% forecast, though, might not cut it for a stock priced for a comeback. At a price-to-earnings ratio around 55, I think Intel needs that number climbing faster than its own forecast suggests.

news.Title: Best Buy Gives Investors a Reason to Take a Second Look
news.Content:
Best Buy Co., Inc. (NYSE: BBY ) isn't the kind of retailer that immediately comes to mind when you think about companies with a wide economic moat. After all, consumers can buy the same electronics from Amazon, Walmart, or directly from manufacturers. Still, Best Buy has managed to carve out a fairly durable position in the consumer electronics market by combining its stores, online business, product expertise, and services.

The company operates more than 1,000 stores across North America and generated $41.7 billion in revenue in fiscal 2026. One of its biggest advantages is that it doesn't just sell electronics. Customers can also turn to Best Buy for installation, repairs, technical support, and consultations. Its Marketplace and Best Buy Ads businesses are also giving the company more ways to generate higher-margin revenue beyond simply selling products. Read about the company's moat here.

The latest results suggest that the strategy is beginning to pay off. In the second quarter of fiscal 2027, comparable sales rose 4.1%, while revenue increased to $9.78 billion from $9.44 billion a year earlier. Adjusted EPS jumped 15% to $1.47. Best Buy also raised its full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $6.70-$6.90, up from its previous range of $6.30-$6.60.

Best Buy's Dividend

Best Buy currently pays a quarterly dividend of $0.96 per share, or $3.84 annually. With the stock recently trading around $87, that works out to a dividend yield of about 4.4%. That's roughly in line with the company's five-year average yield of around 4.3%, according to Yahoo Finance. Btw, there's another stock trading at an even lower multiple and has a dividend yield over 6%. Find here.

The company raised its dividend by 1% earlier this year and has continued paying $0.96 per share each quarter. The latest dividend was declared in August and paid on October 8. The dividend also looks reasonably well covered by earnings. Using the midpoint of management's $6.70-$6.90 adjusted EPS guidance, the $3.84 annual dividend represents a payout ratio of about 56%. That isn't particularly aggressive and leaves the company with room to reinvest in the business, pay down debt, and return additional cash to shareholders through buybacks.

Free cash flow tells a similar story. Best Buy Co., Inc. (NYSE:BBY) generated $1.30 billion in operating cash flow during the first six months of fiscal 2027 and spent $344 million on capital expenditures. That left the company with roughly $952 million in free cash flow. It paid $405 million in dividends during the same period, meaning dividends consumed less than half of its free cash flow. That's a positive sign for income investors. Best Buy isn't relying on additional borrowing or cutting back sharply on investments just to keep the dividend going.

Story Continues

Is Best Buy Stock Cheap?

The valuation is arguably more interesting than the dividend yield itself. The stock is currently trading at around 13.6 times forward earnings, compared with a trailing P/E of roughly 15 times. At 13.6 times forward earnings, investors are paying about $13.60 for every $1 of expected earnings. That's equivalent to a forward earnings yield of roughly 7.4%.

For a company expecting adjusted EPS of $6.70-$6.90 this year, that doesn't look like an expensive valuation, particularly after management raised its earnings guidance. It also gives investors some room to earn a decent total return from both the dividend and future earnings growth. There are still some risks to consider. Best Buy Co., Inc. (NYSE:BBY) operates on thin margins, with an operating margin of just 4.3% in the latest quarter. That means even relatively small changes in consumer spending, product margins, or tariffs can have a meaningful impact on profits. The company also has to compete with Amazon and other retailers, while the fast pace of change in consumer electronics can make inventory management more difficult.

Even so, the latest quarter was encouraging. Best Buy managed to grow sales while also improving profitability, and the higher earnings guidance suggests management is becoming more confident about the year ahead. At around 13.6 times forward earnings, the stock looks reasonably valued rather than expensive.

For dividend investors, that's an attractive combination. A yield of roughly 4.4%, a payout ratio in the mid-50% range, solid free cash flow coverage and a relatively modest forward P/E give Best Buy a decent balance of income and valuation support. The business still faces plenty of competition and operates in a challenging retail environment, but investors don't appear to be paying a premium price for the dividend at today's valuation.

While we acknowledge the potential of BBY as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 3 Dividend Stocks to Buy in October and Hold for 20 Years
news.Content:
Twenty years is a long time to hold a stock. It's long enough to live through a few recessions, a couple of CEO changes, and more than one round of investors declaring a company's best days are behind it.

The dividend stocks worth owning for that long are the ones making real, sometimes uncomfortable moves right now to make sure the business is still worth owning in 2046. These three are each doing exactly that, and are solid buys this month.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

1. Kimberly-Clark is betting its 54-year streak on a $48.7 billion reinvention

Kimberly-Clark (NASDAQ: KMB) has raised its dividend for 54 consecutive years, a streak that survived the 2008 financial crisis and a pandemic that scrambled toilet paper demand overnight. What makes it worth buying now isn't the streak itself, though, it's what the company is doing to protect it for the next two decades.

Last year, Kimberly-Clark agreed to acquire Kenvue , the consumer health company behind Tylenol, Band-Aid, and Listerine, in a stock-and-cash deal worth roughly $48.7 billion, with the combination expected to close in the second half of 2026 and generate about $2.1 billion in annual cost and revenue synergies.

That's a lot of money and complexity for a company best known for Huggies and tissues to take on. I think it's the right call. Paper products are a mature, low-growth category. Consumer health brands people reach for by habit, not by price comparison, are a stickier business to own for the long run.

Kimberly-Clark raised its dividend again the last two years, even while working to close the deal, a signal that management isn't treating shareholder payouts as something to sacrifice. Kimberly-Clark's dividend increase also makes it a Dividend King, a company that has grown its dividend for at least 50 consecutive years. This is a strong sign of company strength.

2. PepsiCo is finally trimming the fat, with an activist investor making sure

PepsiCo (NASDAQ: PEP) spent years adding brands until its portfolio became harder to manage than it needed to be. That's changing. Last year, after Elliott Investment Management built a $4 billion stake and pushed for faster action, PepsiCo struck a collaborative agreement to accelerate its Strategy 2030 plan, which includes closing plants, shutting down redundant production lines, and eliminating nearly 20% of its U.S. SKUs by early 2026, according to the AP.

Story Continues

Cutting a fifth of your product lineup sounds dramatic, and in the near term, it will likely cost the company shelf space and sales. But a leaner PepsiCo focused on what's actually growing is a better bet for 20 years than one spreading itself across thousands of slow-moving items.

The clearest sign the strategy is working so far is Poppi, the prebiotic soda PepsiCo acquired last year, which generated more than $500 million in year-to-date retail sales, up more than 50% from a year earlier, according to Entrepreneur. That's the kind of brand a lean and simplified, better-run PepsiCo should be able to produce more of.

3. Sysco just bet $29 billion that restaurants want a different way to buy food

Sysco (NYSE: SYY) just made its boldest move in years, agreeing to acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot for about $29 billion, financed through a mix of new debt and cash and stock paid to Restaurant Depot's owners.

The deal pushes Sysco into the cash-and-carry wholesale model, where customers pay up front and haul away their own supplies through roughly 166 warehouse locations across 35 states, a very different business from Sysco's traditional delivery-truck network, per Reuters.

Investors didn't love the news at first; the stock fell about 12% on worries over how much debt Sysco is taking on to get it done. That reaction is fair to note, and it's a real risk worth watching over the next few years. But Sysco also reaffirmed its commitment to its current dividend even as it absorbs the deal, and it's adding a cost-conscious, higher-margin channel that reaches independent restaurants; something its delivery business doesn't always serve well. Paying more up front for a broader reach is a 20-year trade I'd make for a company already running a food distribution network that most of its rivals can't match.

Why hold for 20 years?

None of these three moves pays off next quarter, and that's sort of my point. Twenty years is enough time for any messy acquisition to finish working, for a leaner product lineup to prove it was worth the short-term pain, and for a risky bet on debt to either justify itself or get paid down. I'd rather own businesses willing to make an uncomfortable decision today than ones coasting on a streak alone, because the dividend that compounds and matters in 2046 is the one these companies are building the case for right now.

news.Title: 【Follow法人】外資連4天狂砍面板雙虎逾45萬張！台積電遭提款313億元 0050也中箭

台股今（8）日在雙十連假前夕，終場收在49,313點，下跌逾492點，守4萬9千點大關。三大法人今日合計賣超898.95億元，其中外資再砍758.52億元，連3賣累計提款955.53億元。資深台股分析師王兆立表示，外資大幅賣超主要受到美股及日韓股市走弱影響，後續須觀察台積電法說會後的市場反應。觀察個股動向，面板雙虎友達（2409）、群創（3481）已連續4個交易日遭外資調節，合計賣超逾45萬張；權王台積電也被提款約313.7億元，0050也中箭擠進賣超前三大。

外資今日賣超前三大：00406A、友達、0050

外資今日賣超以主動中信台灣收益（00406A）居冠，單日遭砍59,463張；面板股友達（2409）則遭賣超59,450張，僅差13張排名第二；元大台灣50（0050）遭調節逾5.1萬張，位居第三。

值得注意的是，面板雙虎同步遭外資調節，除了友達排名第二，群創（3481）也遭賣超逾2萬張；大型權值股鴻海（2317）則遭賣超逾2.5萬張，位居第五。

進一步觀察本周外資籌碼，友達自周一以來連續4個交易日遭外資賣超，累計達43.48萬張；群創雖在周三一度獲外資買超，但本周仍累計遭賣超2.34萬張。兩檔合計來看，本周外資已賣超面板雙虎約45.83萬張。

ETF方面，除了主動中信台灣收益及元大台灣50外，凱基台灣TOP50（009816）也遭賣超逾3萬張，群益台灣精選高息（00919）則遭調節逾2.2萬張，雙雙擠進賣超前十大。

此外，權王台積電（2330）今日也遭外資賣超12,302張，以今日收盤價2,550元估算，外資單日提款金額約313.7億元。

外資今日買超前三大：00403A、南亞科、中石化

外資今日買超以主動統一升級50（00403A）居冠，單日獲加碼逾3萬張；記憶體股南亞科（2408）獲買超2.17萬張，排名第二；中石化（1314）則獲買超2.16萬張，位居第三。

傳產股方面，除了中石化外，台塑（1301）也獲外資買超逾1.4萬張，中鋼（2002）、台泥（1101）則分別獲加碼逾1萬張，均擠進買超前十大。

外資再砍758億元！分析師：台積電法說後是關鍵

王兆立表示，外資今日賣壓明顯擴大，主要受到國際股市表現不佳影響，包括美股前一交易日收黑，以及日韓股市同步走弱，使外資在台股現貨市場加大調節力道。

王兆立進一步指出，台積電今日公布營收，雖然數字優於公司原先預估的高標，但部分外資機構預期更高，因此實際表現未必完全符合期待。他推測，外資期貨空單增加約4千口，可能與營收公布後的部位調整有關。

展望後續法人動向，王兆立表示，外資在下周四台積電法說會前可能維持相對中性的態度，短期仍須觀察連假期間美股表現。他認為，市場對法說會已有一定期待，若利多逐漸鈍化，法說會後反而可能出現較大的調節壓力，屆時法人多空方向才會更加明朗。

三大法人賣超898億元 外資連3天提款台股955億元

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日延續賣超態勢，合計賣超898.95億元。其中，外資再砍758.52億元，呈連3賣，累計賣超955.53億元。

投信今日則是由賣轉買，合計買超46.88億元，終止連3賣。

自營商則合計賣超187.3億元，其中自行買賣賣超21.31億元，避險操作賣超165.99億元，已呈連2賣，累計賣超265.26億元。

台股在雙十連假前夕，終場收在49,313點，下跌逾492點。成交量約9,201億元。權王台積電（2330）終場收在2,550元，下跌35元。

news.Title: 盤後／台股重挫492點　戰犯是它
news.Content:
台股今（8）日受到美股走弱及台積電ADR下挫拖累，開盤後震盪走低，盤中最低來到49189點，權值股全面承壓使大盤維持弱勢整理，終場重挫492點，收在49313點，成交值進一步降至8696億元。法人指出，目前台股仍處於歷史高檔區，大型電子權值股短線面臨獲利了結賣壓，不過隨著上市櫃公司9月營收陸續公布，基本面表現亮眼且營收創高的中小型題材股仍有逢低資金積極進駐。短線市場焦點將持續落在外資籌碼動向、國際政經情勢與企業基本面表現，預期大盤指數將維持高檔震盪整理，盤面資金則持續向具備實質業績成長題材的個股快速輪動。

美債標售回穩 法說觀望升溫

國際市場方面，美國10年期公債拍賣結果優於市場原先擔憂，得標利率雖達5.3%創2000年以來新高，但仍低於預發行利率1.88個基點，反映買方實質需求強勁；非交易商投資人認購比率達97.5%創歷史新高，認購倍數2.77倍亦寫下2016年以來高點，顯示美債殖利率水準已吸引長線避險資金進場，30年期美債殖利率隨後回落至5.673%，市場預期聯準會10月升息機率降至17.2%。然而費半與台積電ADR走跌仍重擊台股，晶圓代工龍頭台積電（2330）將於10月15日召開法說會，市場高度關注第3季獲利、2奈米量產進度與先進封裝擴產，法說前觀望氣氛濃厚，今日下跌35元收在2550元。

車用運算加溫 被動元件亮燈

相較於大型權值股走弱，被動元件族群今日逆勢成為吸金指標。隨著人工智慧伺服器及高效能運算對高階積層陶瓷電容與晶片電阻需求快速激增，加上消費性電子傳統旺季備貨啟動、車用電子市場滲透率持續提升，高耐壓與高容值規格產品供需轉趨吃緊，市場再度浮現漲價題材。在買盤強力湧入下，精密陶瓷基板廠九豪（6127）、電解電容廠金山電（8042）以及精密電阻廠光頡（3624）今日強勢攻上漲停板，保護元件大廠興勤（2428）大漲5.62%，電感元件廠千如（3236）亦勁揚近5%，帶動被動元件族群成為大盤重挫過程中表現最為亮眼的電子次族群之一。

高速光通需求 石英元件齊揚

石英元件族群同樣在盤面逆勢展現強勁抗跌力道。法人指出，人工智慧伺服器、高速光通訊、800G與1.6T網通設備以及低軌衛星通訊需求持續升溫，帶動高階石英振盪器與頻率元件市場供需全面吃緊，加上第4季正式進入電子產業傳統拉貨旺季，產能利用率走揚與產品漲價效益仍具備進一步發酵空間。受題材激勵，安碁（6174）與泰藝（8289）今日雙雙強攻漲停，加高（8182）與希華（2484）均強漲逾4%，台嘉碩（3221）及石英元件龍頭晶技（3042）亦逆勢收紅。整體而言台股跌幅雖重，但資金積極在零組件與營收成長股間健康輪動，個股表現依舊可期。

news.Title: 〈台股盤後〉國慶連假前觀望賣壓沉重 終場跌492點失守5日線
news.Content:
台股今(8)日受美股四大指數收低走弱，加上雙十國慶連假前避險賣壓沉重，開低走低，早盤一度重挫逾600點，電子權值股多檔走弱，盤面上以9月營收亮眼及塑化、被動元件、防疫概念相關族群表現較佳，終場跌492.93點，收49,313.44點，跌破5日線，周K連4紅，成交量再縮減至8,696.96億元。

在電子權值股部分，受前晚費半下跌超過1%影響，台積電(2330-TW)開低走低，最後一盤遭砍6,030張，跌1.35%或35元收2,550元，也失守5日線；聯發科(2454-TW)跌3%，股后川湖(2330-TW)連吞2根停板，台達電(2308-TW)跌1.26%，鴻海(2317-TW)跌1.19%、日月光投控(3711-TW)漲1.64%。

被動元件受漲價效應及台廠喜迎轉單紅利，包括光頡(3624-TW)、鈺邦(6449-TW)漲3.63%，鈺鎧(5228 -TW)、金山電(8042-TW)、九豪(3711-TW)、勤凱(4760-TW)等連袂飆漲停，千如(3236-TW)漲4.8%。

塑化股部分，傳美國將聯手以色列發動大空襲，布蘭特原油期貨大漲，族群多檔紅光滿面，包括台塑(1301-TW)漲7.82%，台塑化(6505-TW)、台化(1326-TW)漲2-3%；永捷(4714 -TW)、台苯(1310-TW)漲3-4%。

記憶體DRAM類股因美光大漲，激勵南亞科(2408-TW)漲3.5%、廣穎(4973 -TW)飆上漲停板、十銓(4967-TW)、至上(8112-TW)漲1.6%

此外，受流感逼近14萬人次感染影響，題材推升防疫概念股上揚，包括美德醫療-DR(9103-TW)、恆大(1325-TW)、南六(6504-TW)、萬林-創(6645-TW)、合世 (1781-TW)5檔收漲停，熱映(3373-TW)漲8%，太景*-KY(4157-TW)漲9.12%。

分析師表示，台股今日仍面臨國慶連假前觀望態度濃厚，持續陷入量縮格局，尤其在本周二台股創新高後，漲勢趨緩，展望下周包括萬眾矚目10月15日台積電法說會，仍要持續關注，整體電子股在AI相關產業營收正向趨勢不變下，投資人只要不過度追高，仍可關注營收優秀個股，逢低布局進場，包括光通訊、被動元件及特用化學類股題材也可持續關注。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》物流自動化—TER、UPS、FDX
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-08 14:52:13 數位內容中心 發佈

Teradyne（TER.US）

10月5日，Teradyne宣布策略投資Bright Machines，並規劃把機器人與測試技術整合進軟體定義製造平台。Bright Machines已在10多個國家部署超過130座微型工廠，這次投資把設備聯網、控制軟體與跨站點複製能力放到同一架構中。

UPS（UPS.US）

10月1日，UPS推出UPS Secure Commerce，整合保險、貨件保護與風險管理工具，並結合代理型人工智慧（agentic AI）協助託運人判斷高價值訂單是否放行。10月7日公司再宣布旺季前啟用或升級多地自動化設施，連結資料閉環與場站作業。

FedEx（FDX.US）

本週FedEx最明確的訊號，是把物流資料與交易流程綁在一起推進。公司擴大FedEx Dataworks與Stripe合作，將物流資料串接支付處理與小型企業融資服務；同時已向Harbinger Motors訂購2000輛中型電動卡車，並行推進運輸網路數據化。

GXO Logistics（GXO.US）

GXO本週可記住的主軸，是以跨站點標準化管理支撐合約物流擴張。公司與Columbia Sportswear簽署10年合作，負責法國康布雷樞紐的入庫、倉儲與履約；同步推進全球統一勞動管理系統（LMS）試點，覆蓋5個國家。

CMA CGM

10月1日，CMA CGM完成對FedEx Supply Chain的14億美元收購，之後CEVA Logistics在北美新增約3400萬平方英尺倉儲面積與約130家客戶。公司並明確表示將加快在北美網路部署自動化與機器人技術，直接把併購轉向倉網整合。

Amazon（AMZN.US）

10月1日，Amazon位於紐約的SWF1倉庫員工發起罷工，焦點集中在安全防護、訓練流程與緊急應變程序。這則事件未涉及新設備導入，但把高自動化履約中心的人員管理與現場安全，拉回成為本週最直接的營運訊號。

news.Title: 國慶連假後可撿台積電鑽石？9月營收月減 分析師：下周先蹲後跳再衝新高
news.Content:
晶圓代工龍頭台積電（2330）今（8）日公布 9 月營收，不僅持續站穩 5 千億元大關，更衝上歷年次高紀錄；今年前三季累計營收逼近 3.9 兆元，一舉改寫歷史新高。不過，由於單月出現「微幅月減 0.6%」，意外引發部分股民對下週一股價的焦慮，甚至有人觀望「真的可以彎腰撿鑽石嗎？」對此，分析師表示，下週台積電極可能呈現「先跌後漲」格局，拉回修正後仍有機會再創歷史新高。

對於台積電9月營收月減，看空網友紛紛表示「營收到頂了，要走下坡了，坐穩囉」、「週一一根（跌停）」、「月減，下禮拜一根」；但也有不少看好後市的投資人興奮高喊「漲停預備」，甚至期待拉回甜甜價「都沒機會給加碼，看這次能不能到 2300 以下」、「準備彎腰撿鑽石」。

分析師：月減影響有限 法說會前「清洗籌碼」反而有利

摩爾投顧分析師何基鼎分析，雖然近期大盤操作節奏不算特別順暢，但台積電9月僅月減 0.6%，完全落在合理範圍內，基本面並無不佳，他強調，現階段市場真正的關鍵不在於單月營收，而是下周四（15日）即將登場的台積電法說會。

何基鼎指出，法說會前夕市場往往存在兩派觀點，加上部分信心不足的資金可能因「營收月減」選擇離場，不過，「不堅定的籌碼適度釋出反而是好事」，這能讓整體籌碼面變得更為沉澱與乾淨。籌碼沉澱後，下周大盤與台積電呈現「先跌後漲、再挑戰新高」的機率極大。

對於有意加碼或入場的投資人，何基鼎建議，「節奏放慢，切忌急躁」，要買進完全沒問題，但千萬不要一次性重壓，避免對個人造成過大的心理壓力，可採取「零股交易」或「定期定額」方式分批進場，穩健卡位法說會行情與後續行情。

台積電9 月營收報告，單月合併營收達新台幣 5,118 億 5,700 萬元，雖較上月微幅減少 0.6%，但較去年同期大幅暴增 54.6%，持續站穩 5 千億元大關並創下歷年次高紀錄。

統計台積電前三季營收衝上1兆4,942.43 億元（季增逾 17%），遠超公司原本設定的財測預期，順利突破高標。累計前 9 月營收更來到 3 兆 8,987 億 2,700 萬元，年增 41.1%。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 【公告】群聯 2026年9月合併營收306.39億元 年增370.26%
台積電營收衝近3.9兆新高！網見「月減」戰翻 他喊：下周一彎腰撿鑽石
news.Content:
晶圓代工龍頭台積電（2330）今（8）日公布9月營收，不僅持續站穩5千億元大關，更創下歷年次高紀錄；今年前三季累計營收逼近3.9兆元，改寫歷史新高。不過，由於單月出現微幅月減，在PTT股板引發兩極討論。有人打趣怪「乖乖罷工潮」，也有人挺台積電表示「好學生依然超越高標」，更有不少投資人期待下周一股價拉回「準備彎腰撿鑽石」。對此，《Yahoo奇摩股市》特別整理出網友熱議的四大重點。

重點一：「月減 0.6%」引爆集體焦慮 網力挺：好學生依然突破高標

營收數據一出，迅速在 PTT Stock 板引發熱烈討論。儘管前三季累計營收創下史上新高，但由於單月出現「月減 0.6%」，論壇上瞬間湧現極端情緒。看空網友紛紛喊出「丸子」（完蛋了）、「月減 完蛋 倒閉了」、「要倒了，2000見」、「年底這間爛公司就要倒閉了」、「AI is over」；不過，也有不少人挺台積電表示：「少一天才減 0.6% 根本超強」、「好學生依然突破高標」。

重點二：營收月減原因引猜測 網友打趣怪給「乖乖罷工」

對於月減原因，有網友打趣笑稱是晶片守護神「乖乖罷工潮影響 !!!!!!!!!」；不過也有不少理性網友指出，9 月天數比 8 月少一天（30 天 vs. 31 天），若以天數估算應減少 3.2%，結果營收僅微減 0.6%，顯見拉貨動能依然極強，紛紛留言：「九月少一天 月減不是常識嗎？是在那邊哭X什麼」、「少一天該月減 3% 才少不到 1%，所以還是成長吧」、「1/31=3.2%，3.2%-0.6%= +2.6%，滿手GG 舒舒服服」、「放假放太多」。

重點三：真金白銀持股大戶火藥味十足

面對部分沒持股網友將「月減」視為利空，手握股票的真金白銀大戶紛紛爆氣回嗆：「賣掉你要買什麼？說月減這樣很差的只是想唱空」、「一堆人投資眼界就是月減了」。更有網友酸「一張都沒有的看月減」，引來大戶光速反擊「什麼一張都沒有，林北有十張啦！」連帶炸出更多實力股東留言「我有 20幾張好嗎……我意思是當時壓別的現在就……嗚嗚」。

重點四：利空即利多？ 網友興奮喊「準備彎腰撿鑽石」

也有不少投資人將這次的微幅月減視為難得的拉回加碼機會，興奮留言期待甜甜價：「都沒機會給加碼，看這次能不能到 2300 以下」、「快 A 回 500，我要買」、「記憶卡哇都下去了，全部一起陪葬」，甚至有人直接高喊「準備彎腰撿鑽石」！

台積電9 月營收報告，單月合併營收達新台幣 5,118 億 5,700 萬元，雖較上月微幅減少 0.6%，但較去年同期大幅暴增 54.6%，持續站穩 5 千億元大關並創下歷年次高紀錄。統計前三季營收衝上1兆4,942.43 億元（季增逾 17%），遠超公司原本設定的財測預期，順利突破高標。累計前 9 月營收更來到 3 兆 8,987 億 2,700 萬元，年增 41.1%。

news.Title: 台積電9月營收5118.57億元寫單月次高 Q3登1.49兆元同締新猷飛越財測高標
news.Content:
晶圓代工龍頭台積電(2330-TW)今(8)日公告9月營收5118.57億元，月減0.6%、年增54.6%，連續2個月衝破5000億元大關，創歷史次高，第三季營收1兆4942.44億元，創單季新高，超越財測高標水準，季增17.62%、年增50.94%；累計前9月營收約3兆8987.27億元，年增41.1%。

依照台積電前次法說預估，第三季營收將達446億至458億美元，中位數季增12%、年增37%，以1美元兌換新台幣32元匯率假設，第三季新台幣營收約介於1兆4272億元至1兆4656億元，此次再度營收超越財測高標；獲利率方面，台積電估第三季毛利率落在65%至67%，營益率預估56%至58%。

台積電董事長魏哲家先前於法說上指出，市場對運算能力的需求持續增加，支撐先進製程晶片需求維持強勁，台積電的客戶及客戶的客戶，尤其是雲端服務供應商，持續釋出非常強勁的需求訊號與正面展望，因此公司對 AI 多年期結構性成長趨勢仍具高度信心。

台積電也預計將於10月15日召開法說會，屆時將公告第三季財報外，外界也關注第四季及明年展望，AI成長趨勢、先進製程與先進封測狀況、海外廠區進度以及資本支出規劃等議題。

news.Title: 台股跌492.93點
news.Content:
（中央社台北8日電）台北股市今天開低走低，收盤跌492.93點，為49313.44點，跌幅0.99%，成交金額新台幣8696.96億元。

加權指數開盤為49783.06點，盤中最高49783.06點，最低49189.77點；不含金融股指數44161.08點，跌413.65點。

八大類股漲跌幅：泥窯股跌0.41%、食品股漲0.32%、塑化股漲0.35%、紡織股漲0.82%、機電股跌1.07%、造紙股跌0.01%、營建股漲0.28%、金融股跌1.68%。

委買張數2456萬8545張，委賣張數1449萬4739張，成交張數1029萬5269張。

收盤時上漲437家，下跌551家，持平118家。

成交量前5名個股為主動中信台灣收益、友達、台塑、群益臺灣加權正2、台玻。

漲幅前5名個股為展達、隴華、冠西電、太極、美德醫療-DR。

跌幅前5名個股為川湖、秋雨、松川精密、意騰-KY、嘉晶。1151008

news.Title: 【台股盤後】科技股弱勢收跌492.93點　週線連4紅
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中台北2026年10月8日電）台股今天下跌492.93點，收在49313.44點，成交值新台幣8696.96億元。台股本週累計上漲837.7點，週線連4紅。

電子權值股今天漲跌互見，台積電 (2330) 下跌35元、聯發科 (2454) 下挫145元，台達電 (2308) 和鴻海 (2317) 也都收跌；日月光投控 (3711) 上漲12元、台光電 (2383) 上漲50元、南亞科 (2408) 上漲18元，整體電子類股指數下跌1.07%。

富邦金 (2881) 和國泰金 (2882) 分別下挫1.61%及2.65%，整體金融股指數下跌1.68%，表現疲弱。

傳統產業股漲跌互見，電纜類股指數下跌逾1.2%，玻璃類股指數下挫逾2.5%，表現相對弱勢；水泥和紡織類股指數收漲。

西伯利亞傳出第2起疑似鼠疫病例，防疫概念股在市場資金湧入下，包括康那香 (9919) 、恆大 (1325) 和南六 (6504) 等強攻漲停。

散熱廠奇鋐 (3017) 及子公司富世達 (6805) 因法務部調查局至新莊廠區，針對特定員工進行搜索及調查。奇鋐和富世達股價分別下跌105元及85元。

高價股方面，股王信驊 (5274) 和股后川湖 (2059) 盤中重挫跌停，信驊終場跌勢大幅收斂，下跌265元，川湖則以跌停作收，為10615元。隨著愛普 (6531) 股價跌破1000元大關，收在980元，台股千金股陣容縮至55檔。

兆豐國際投顧副總經理黃國偉表示，油價、通膨、殖利率和利率政策等彼此密切關連牽動，是市場近期關注重點。

news.Title: Zacks Earnings Trends Highlights: Micron, Nvidia, Alphabet, JPMorgan, Citigroup and Wells Fargo
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – October 8, 2026– Zacks Director of Research Sheraz Mian says, "The growth momentum is broad-based, with 15 of the 16 Zacks sectors expected to enjoy positive earnings growth and the outlook steadily improving."

Banks Under Pressure from Spiking Yields Ahead of Q3 Results

Note: The following is an excerpt from this week's Earnings Trends report. You can access the full report that contains detailed historical actual and estimates for the current and following periods, please click here>>>

Here are the key points:

The overall setup for the Q3 earnings season remains very favorable, with earnings growth expected to be in the double digits for the 8th consecutive quarter. The growth momentum is broad-based, with 15 of the 16 Zacks sectors expected to enjoy positive earnings growth and the outlook steadily improving.

Total S&P 500 earnings in Q3 are currently expected to increase +24.6% from the same period last year on +11.5% higher revenues.

The revisions trend remains positive, sustaining the favorable revisions trend that has been in place for a year now. Since the start of Q3, earnings estimates have moved higher for half of the 16 Zacks sectors. We are seeing a similar trend for Q4 and full-year 2027 as well.

Micron MU and Nvidia NVDA continue to be material contributors to the Tech sector's growth picture. Excluding Nvidia, Micron, and Alphabet GOOGL, which enjoyed an outsized gain in the preceding period, Q3 earnings for the rest of the Tech sector would be +20.7% (vs. +43.4% otherwise).

Bank Earnings in the Spotlight

JPMorgan JPM, Citigroup C and Wells Fargo WFC will kick off the Q3 reporting cycle for the Finance sector on Tuesday, October 13th. These bank stocks have lost ground lately in reaction to rising Treasury yields.

Over the last three months, when Treasury yields spiked higher, JPMorgan and Wells Fargo shares lost -0.3% and -6.2%, lagging the S&P 500 index's +4.2% gain. We should keep in mind, however, that estimates for JPMorgan modestly increased, while those for Wells Fargo largely remained stable over this three-month period. Q3 estimates for the Finance sector as a whole increased since the start of the period.

Higher interest rates are generally seen as beneficial for these banks, but spiking yields of the type we have been experiencing are negative for these banks from several angles, ranging from causing paper losses at their available-for-sale bond portfolios to squeezed net interest margins through surging deposit betas and generally negative effects on credit demand and credit quality.

Story Continues

Trading volumes have remained very strong in recent quarters, but mid-quarter updates from management teams suggest that they will be below the levels seen in the preceding period. Negative developments in the treasury bond market have also clouded the outlook for deal flow, with several high-profile IPOs delayed as a result. It will be interesting to see how management teams, particularly JPMorgan's leadership, will describe the operating environment on their earnings call next week.

For the sector as a whole, Q3 earnings are expected to increase by +3.4% from the same period last year on +6.3% higher revenues, which would follow the sector's +22.4% earnings growth on +13.2% higher revenues in the preceding period.

The Earnings Big Picture

We have been showing here how Q3 estimates moved higher since the quarter got underway.

As is the case with estimates for 2026 Q4, estimates for full-year 2027 are also moving higher.

Since the beginning of July, estimates for 2027 have increased for 10 of the 16 Zacks sectors, with Tech, Energy, Finance, and Industrials leading the way.

We will see how this revisions trend evolves as companies report Q3 results and share updates on developments in their businesses.

news.Title: 台積電尾盤急殺6000張！台股收跌492點 失守5日線
news.Content:
台股今（8）日開低震盪，指數受台積電尾盤遭大砍6030張影響，終場收49313點失守5日線，下跌492點，跌幅0.99%，成交量8600億。

權值股部分，台積電早盤開低震盪，尾盤突遭賣壓侵襲，6030張賣單影響股價由2560元下挫至收盤價2550元，下跌35元，跌幅1.35%，聯發科來到4690元，下跌145元，跌幅3%，鴻海、台達電、也有逾1%的跌幅。

觀察今日盤面，台塑三寶逆勢撐盤，台塑大漲7.82%，終場收81.3元，突破80元關卡，台塑化來到110.5元，上漲3.27%，台化也有逾2%的漲幅，南亞則下跌1.27%，收310元。

被動元件族群也有不錯的表現，光頡、勤凱、鈺鎧、九豪、金山電亮燈收漲停，禾伸堂、千如、興勤也有逾4~5%的漲幅。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 台積電9月成績單飆破5千億！Q3營收1.49兆超越財測高標
news.Content:
晶圓代工龍頭台積電8日公布2026年9月營收，單月合併營收衝上新台幣5118億5700萬元，較去年同期大幅暴增54.6％，持續站穩5千億元大關；累計前9月營收更達3兆8987億2700萬元，較去年同期大增41.1％，續寫歷年同期新高紀錄。

根據台積電公布數據，9月合併營收約為5118億5700萬元，雖然較8月的5148億600萬元微幅減少0.6％，但與2025年同期的3309億8千萬元相比，年增率達54.6％，營運維持在歷史高檔水位。

回顧台積電先前法說會展望，原預估第3季營收介於446億至458億美元，在假設匯率32元兑1美元，折合新台幣約1兆4272億至1兆4656億元。隨著7月營收繳出4675.8億元、8月飆上5148億元歷史新高，加上9月續穩5千億元大關，第3季整體營收1.49兆超出財測上限逾286億元，繳出傲人成績。

累計表現方面，台積電2026年1至9月合併營收約為3兆8987億2,700萬元，相較去年同期的2兆7629億6400萬元，年成長率達41.1％。市場分析，受惠全球AI終端算力需求持續爆發，加上各大科技巨頭對先進製程與先進封裝產能拉貨動能強勁，推升台積電營運動能持續走揚。

news.Title: 台積電9月營收寫次高，Q3勝財測/續創新高
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-08 13:59:53 新聞中心 發佈

台積電(2330)今(8)日公佈今(2026)年9月合併營收為5,118.57億元，較上月創下的歷史新高5,148.05億元微減0.6%、仍創下單月歷史次高，相較去年同期則大幅成長54.6%。第三季單季營收約為1兆4942億元，再創單季歷史新高，季增約17.6%、年增約50.9%。累計今年1至9月營收約為3兆8,987.27億元，年成長41.1%。

news.Title: 台積電9月營收創同期新高　第3季衝歷史新高
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年10月8日電）在15日召開法說會前，台積電 (2330) 今天公布自結9月營收新台幣5118.57億元，為歷年同期新高，較8月創下的5148.06億元歷史最高紀錄小幅下滑0.6%，仍比去年同期增加54.6%，台積電第3季營收達到1兆4942.43億元，創下歷史新高。

台積電先前預期，第3季美元營收將約446億至458億美元，假設平均匯率為1美元兌新台幣32元，台積電第3季營收1兆4942.43億元，超越預期。

法人指出，人工智慧需求強勁，加上智慧手機新機備貨需求升溫，是推升台積電第3季營收創高的主要動力。

台積電9月營收5118.57億元，月減0.6%，年增54.6%。第3季營收1兆4942.43億元，季增17.62%。累計前9月營收3兆8987.27億元，較去年同期增加41.1%。

台積電預計於10月15日召開線上法人說明會，法人預期，受惠輝達（NVIDIA）Vera Rubin新平台及2奈米強勁需求，台積電第4季營收可望進一步攀高。

除營運展望外，台積電資本支出計畫、先進製程和先進封裝進展、毛利率展望，以及全球產能布局等，都是市場關注的重點。

news.Title: 台股收盤／連假前變天！台積電挫35元台股跌492點　記憶體被動零星點火
news.Content: 受到美股四大指數全面收黑，以及美國公債殖利率攀升衝擊，台股今（8）日開低走低，盤中雖一度出現反彈，但買盤追價意願不足，加上國慶3天連假即將到來，市場觀望氣氛濃厚。台股今（8）日收跌492.93點，櫃買跌0.87%，成交8696.96億元，台積電重挫35元，國慶連假前賣壓湧現。 台積電重挫35元拖累大盤　8696億成交金額透露市場不安 加權指數終場收在49,313.44點，下跌492.93點，跌幅0.99%，成交金額達8,696.96億元；代表中小型股的櫃買指數同步收黑，終場收426.71點，下跌3.75點，跌幅0.87%，成交金額2,521.06億元，上市櫃合計成交金額達1兆1,218.02億元。 從盤中走勢觀察，大盤早盤賣壓明顯，指數快速下探後一度拉升，但始終無法翻紅，午盤過後持續在低檔震盪，尾盤再度承壓，顯示市場短線信心仍偏保守。上市股票下跌家數達732家，上漲僅496家，跌多漲少，市場資金明顯轉趨謹慎。 台積電（2330）成為今日壓盤主角，終場收2,550元，下跌35元，跌幅1.35%，由於台積電在加權指數占有重要權重，股價走弱直接拖累大盤表現。另一檔重量級電子股聯發科（2454）收4,690元，下跌145元，跌幅3%，加重電子權值股賣壓，也讓大盤反彈更加吃力。 倫元投顧陳學進分析師認為，受到美債長天期殖利率一度攀抵至24年新高，再度引發市場對通膨與債務持續增加的擔憂，拖累標普500和那斯達克自歷史新高回落外，加上AI投資、油價高檔與房貸成本上升持續壓抑市場情緒，以及國慶連假將至，市場觀望氛圍轉趨濃厚，因此，於連假前最後交易日，部份主力與散戶順勢「入袋為安」實屬人之常情；不過，，在今日震盪拉回的過程中，台股仍是穩穩地守在於10日線、月線及季線之上不墜，顯見多頭震盪續漲的格局並未改變；首先，光通訊族群掀起漲停狂潮，受惠Marvell因客製化AI資料中心需求爆發，大幅上修2028年度營收預估至200億美元，宣告資料中心全面邁向800G、1.6T乃至矽光子(CPO)技術，包括光聖、前鼎、宏捷科、台星科、台亞、全友…等概念股，近期股價表現也都來的相對強勢與亮眼；其次，被動元件族群迎來春燕，AI規格升級帶動積層陶瓷電容(MLCC)結構性大洗牌，日韓因策略調整，逐漸將重心轉移至高容值的MLCC發展，讓台廠喜迎轉單與漲價紅利，包括華新科、光頡、鈺邦、千如、鈺凱、金山電、九豪、勤凱…等連袂大漲上來；其它包括ASIC設計創意、世芯、CCL騰輝電、網通股其陽、石英元件泰藝、希華、安碁、加高、玻纖布建榮、德宏、連接器佳必琪、映興、繼電器冠西電、電子通路益登、以及先進封裝暨自動化設備等概念股，其表現也都不遑多讓，這些都是大家可持續留意的焦點題材。 南亞科逆勢漲3.5%台塑飆7.82%　電子股與傳產股呈現兩樣情 觀察今日成交活絡個股，電子股表現明顯分歧。記憶體股南亞科（2408）逆勢走強，終場收532元，上漲18元，漲幅3.5%，在大盤重挫近500點之際，仍吸引買盤進駐，成為盤面少數亮點。 不過，其他電子股賣壓不輕，國巨*（2327）收635元，下跌12元，跌幅1.85%；華新科（2492）收420元，下跌8元，跌幅1.87%；南亞（1303）收310元，下跌4元，跌幅1.27%。其中環球晶（6488）跌勢最為沉重，終場收1,130元，下跌85元，跌幅達7%，顯示部分半導體相關個股承受較大調節壓力。

news.Title: 開獎了！台積電9月營收 年增54%
news.Content:
同期新高護國神山台積電（2330）今（8）日公布最新營收報告。受惠於高效能運算（HPC）與人工智慧（AI）晶片強勁出貨動能支撐，2026年9月合併營收達新台幣5,118億5,700萬元，年增率高達54.6%；累計前九月營收更衝上3兆8,987億2,700萬元，較去年同期顯著成長41.1%，單月與累計前三季營收同步刷新歷年同期最高紀錄。

根據台積電公布之財務數據，2026年9月合併營收約為5,118.57億元，僅較8月的5,148.06億元微微修正0.6%，整體營運維持在高檔高姿態運作；與2025年同期的3,309.80億元相比，則大幅成長逾五成。累計2026年1月至9月營收達3兆8,987.27億元，相較於2025年同期的2兆7,629.64億元，展現出極強的營運成長力道。

news.Title: 權值股疲軟！台股終場下跌492點　台積電收2550元
news.Content:

長天期美債殖利率重新攀升，引發市場再度對通膨與債務持續增加的擔憂，美股主要指數週三（7日）全面下跌；台股今（8）日開盤小跌23.31點、以49,783.06開出，隨後指數持續走低，盤中一度跌逾600點。終場指數就以49,313.44點作收、下跌492.93點，跌幅0.22％，成交量8,696.96億元。台積電（2330）終場收在2,550元、下跌35元。

電子權值股方面，鴻海（2317）收249元，跌3元；聯發科（2454）收4,690元，下跌145元；廣達（2382）收325.5元，跌9.5元；台達電（2308）以1,965元，跌25元；日月光投控（3711）漲12元，收744元；聯電（2303）收147.5元，下滑1元；大立光（3008）漲185元，收在6,660元。

金融方面，富邦金（2881）收153元，下跌2.5元；國泰金（2882）跌3元，收在110元；中信金（2891）跌1.4元，以67.3元作收；兆豐金（2886）下滑0.5元，收在49.3元；華南金（2880）跌1.1元，收45.8元；第一金（2892）收38.65元，跌0.25元；合庫金（5880）下跌0.1元，以26.45元作收。

今日成交量前10名個股依序友達、台塑、台玻、力積電、中纖、台化、聯電、群創、和桐、南亞。此外，漲幅前五名為隴華、展達、冠西電、太極、美德醫療-DR；至於跌幅前五名則為川湖、秋雨、松川精密、意騰-KY、嘉晶。

news.Title: TSMC’s Quarterly Revenue Jumps 51% After AI Demand Holds Up
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. reported a 51% rise in quarterly revenue, a positive signal for investors trying to gauge the sustainability of a global AI infrastructure buildout.

Most Read from Bloomberg

Apple to Launch Doorbell, Lock, Thermostat Developed With LG

Dalio Says We're Nearing Point Where AI Bubble May Burst

SpaceX in Talks to Borrow $40 Billion to Buy Nvidia Chips

Revenue totaled NT$1.49 trillion ($46.7 billion) over the three-months ended in September, based on Bloomberg News's own calculations. Analysts on average were looking for NT$1.46 trillion.

The Taiwanese chipmaker's strong sales growth reinforced the outlook for AI demand at a time investors are grappling with rising debt levels and regulatory setbacks, as well as calls by OpenAI and Anthropic PBC to pace the development of the emerging technology.

Advanced Micro Devices Inc. boss Lisa Su said this week the company expects chip demand to remain sharply higher over the next few years, while Samsung Electronics Co. reported an almost nine-fold jump in operating profit. AI server assembler Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. also beat quarterly sales estimates this week.

The go-to chipmaker for Nvidia Corp. and Apple Inc., which serves as a barometer for AI demand, has seen its shares hit a record this month, reflecting confidence in its cutting-edge products over the longer term.

TSMC is now also considering a further expansion in Texas due to white-hot AI demand, after pledging $265 billion to create a campus in Arizona. North American customers accounted for more than 75% of the company's overall sales in the first half of this year.

The bigger questions at the 3Q briefing concern 2027 and beyond. TSMC added $100 billion to its Arizona plan in July, while Reuters reports point to a possible Texas hub; any update could test its overseas-dilution guide and signal 2027 capex. Pricing is another focus, with Taiwan media reports pointing to 3-6% wafer-price increases in 2027. Updates on A14, CoWoS expansion and CoPoS development could also show how TSMC plans to respond to Intel's 14A and growing EMIB-T backlog.

- Charles Shum, analyst

news.Title: 台股連假前大跳水！收盤重挫492點 台積電6千張賣單摜殺
news.Content:
美國國債殖利率攀升，引發市場對通膨及債務增加的擔憂，美股四大指數周三全面收低，衝擊台股今（8）日重挫，一度下探49189.77點，收盤跌492.93點，以49313.44點作收，成交量8697億。

權值股帶頭下殺，台積電收最低2550元，爆出6030張賣單，聯發科重挫逾2%，面板股亦下跌，友達及群創分別跌3.56%及2.86%。散熱大廠奇鋐與旗下折富世達於7日同步發布重訊，證實法務部調查局人員已前往富世達新莊的廠區進行搜索，股價分別下挫2.96%及3.46%。

台股7日收49806.37點，小跌16.18點或0.03%，總成交值9743.89億元。三大法人賣超212.57億元，外資賣超130.44億元，投信、自營商分別賣超4.17億元及賣超77.96億元。

林漢偉分析師建議，操作應維持「拉回不追殺、反彈不亂追、汰弱留強」，如果指數量縮拉回、台積電守住重要支撐，屬於多頭正常整理；真正需要提高警覺的是成交量放大、權值股破線，加上櫃買與高本益比中小型股同步轉弱。

美股道瓊下跌341.41點或0.66%，收51,179.87點。S&P500下跌17.16點或0.22%，收7,801.77點。NASDAQ下跌61.20點或0.22%，收27,538.69點。費城半導體下跌151.67點或1.15%，收13,066.15點。

news.Content:
台積電（2330）今（8）日公布9月合併營收，9月營收5118億元，和8月5,148億600萬元相比衰退，仍是史上第2大、史上最高9月，累計今年前九月，營收3兆8987億元，史上最高。

繼8月營收以新台幣5,148億600萬元、首度衝破5,000億元大關並創下歷史新高後，9月能否延續強勁動能，引發高度關注。

台積電今日公佈2026年9月營收報告。2026年9月合併營收約為新台幣5,118億5,700萬元，較上月減少了0.6%，較去年同期增加了54.6%。

累計2026年1至9月營收約為新台幣3兆8,987億2,700萬元，較去年同期增加了41.1%。

台積電董事長魏哲家先前於法說會中預估，第三季美元營收介於446億至458億美元之間；若以1美元兌新台幣32元的假設匯率計算，單季新台幣營收約落在1兆4,272億元至1兆4,656億元之間。

回顧今年第三季前兩個月的表現，7月營收 4,675.8億元、8月營收 5,148.06億元，兩個月累計營收已達9,823.86億元。若要達成財測目標，9月營收僅需4,447.6億元，即可衝破高標。

今天9月營收數字出爐，9 月單月合併營收約為新台幣 5,118.57 億元，加上7月與8月的表現，第三季累計營收合計達 1 兆 4,942.43 億元。不僅遠超財測預期，更順利突破高標，展現強勁的營運動能。

台積電今年營運表現極為亮眼，歷史單月營收前三名全由今年包辦，第一名是今年8月。

第二名是今年9月，第三名是7月，受惠於全球AI與高效能運算（HPC）客戶拉貨不減，7月合併營收突破 4,675.8 億元大關，改寫單月歷史新高。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: Nvidia-backed Firmus closes IPO bookbuilding as investor support falter -Bloomberg
news.Content:
Investing.com -- Australia-based data-center company Firmus Grid has closed bookbuilding for its IPO after investor concerns grew that the offering could be pulled, Bloomberg reported on Thursday, putting a planned multibillion-dollar listing in doubt.

Before you buy NVIDIA: our AI model's stock picks are beating the market by 120%+. See the list now »

The company was seeking to raise $5.5 billion including a greenshoe option, with an offer price of A$11 a share implying a valuation of A$43.7 billion ($30.4 billion).

Bookbuilding closed as scheduled on Thursday morning, but there was no clear indication of the final price or structure, according to people familiar with the matter cited by Bloomberg.

Firmus had brought forward the bookbuilding deadline to Thursday from Friday after initially seeing demand exceed the offer size, Bloomberg reported.

The report highlighted that some prospective investors became more cautious over the possibility that existing shareholders could sell stock soon after the listing, creating an overhang.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

The uncertainty also hit Maas Group Holdings, a Firmus backer.

Its shares fell as much as 30% in Sydney, their biggest recorded decline, as speculation mounted over whether the IPO would proceed. Maas said it was aware of market commentary but did not know of any undisclosed information explaining the share-price move.

The potential listing had been on track to rank among Australia's largest-ever IPOs, comparable with Medibank's offering in 2014, which raised just under $5 billion.

Firmus began as a Bitcoin mining operation in Australia in 2019 and has since benefited from surging demand for AI infrastructure across Asia, building a pipeline of data-center projects in Australia and Singapore.

The company has secured $2 billion in commitments from investors including Nvidia and Blackstone, while Jane Street is another existing shareholder. It also raised $505 million in an April funding round led by Coatue Management.

Proceeds from the IPO would have been used to buy GPUs for Firmus's first data center in Batam, Indonesia, being developed with DayOne Data Centers under an eight-year partnership with Nvidia.

The struggles come as AI-related companies have driven a wave of fundraising across global equity markets, while investor sentiment has recently become more cautious over the pace of borrowing and spending.

news.Title: Fed轉鷹、美元走強，新興市場9月遭外資撤資263億美元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，國際金融協會(IIF)週三(7日)公布，新興市場股票與債券9月遭外國投資人撤資263億美元，為6月以來首次單月淨流出。聯準會(Fed)升息並釋出偏鷹派訊號，推高美國公債殖利率及美元，削弱風險資產吸引力；其中股票流出約192億美元，債券流出70億美元。IIF指出，撤資壓力在9月下半月加劇，硬通貨債券基金於Fed決策當週轉為資金流出，新興市場美元信用利差同步擴大。主席凱文．華許(Kevin Warsh)領導的Fed進行2023年以來首次升息，並暗示仍可能進一步收緊政策，加上日本央行政策利率升至1995年以來最高水準、先進經濟體普遍緊縮，提高第四季新興市場利差交易的門檻。

股票市場撤資主要受到韓股大量外資賣盤拖累。IIF表示，外資今年多數時間持續減碼韓股，9月賣壓達到高峰，此前韓國綜合股價指數(KOSPI)今年已上漲62%。資金退潮也與AI帶動的科技股行情降溫同時發生，投資人在估值偏高的晶片與科技股實現獲利，令部分亞洲市場面臨調節壓力。

新興市場債券9月各區域均出現資金流出，為3月中東衝突升級以來首次單月淨流出，但今年累計仍吸引外資流入2,460億美元。股票市場則持續失血，今年累計流出1,139億美元，遠高於去年同期的273億美元；排除中國後，累計流出達1,515億美元，顯示今年新興市場股票的外資撤退程度，明顯高於債券。
